;Disasters and accidents
*A fire at a refugee camp in [[Nigeria]] kills eight and leaves 15,000 homeless. The residents are people displaced by ongoing conflict with [[Boko Haram]]. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-nigeria-security-insurgency/fire-kills-at-least-eight-destroys-homes-in-northeast-nigeria-camp-idUKKCN1QX0EA (Reuters)]
*[[2019 Midwestern U.S. floods]]
**Flooding over large portions of [[Nebraska]] leave one dead and two missing with over 900 people using emergency shelters. Many roads and highways in the state are also closed. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2019/03/16/nebraska-flooding-worst-50-years-following-bomb-cyclone-storm/3184806002/ (''USA Today'')]
;Law and crime
*[[Terrorism in Ireland]], [[Terrorism in the United Kingdom]]
**The village of [[Derrylin]], close to the border between [[Northern Ireland]] and the [[Republic of Ireland]], is sealed off after a suspicious object is found. The object is later determined to be “nothing untoward”. [https://www.irishtimes.com/news/ireland/irish-news/border-village-sealed-off-after-reports-of-suspicious-object-1.3828864 (''Irish Times'')]
*[[Colombia|Colombia's]] [[Migración Colombia|migration authority]] detains and expels an alleged spy working for [[Cuba|Cuba's]] [[Dirección de Inteligencia|Intelligence Directorate]]. [https://www.eltiempo.com/colombia/otras-ciudades/expulsan-a-espia-cubano-que-rondaba-la-base-militar-de-palanquero-338340 (''El Tiempo'')]  
;Politics and elections
*[[Yellow vests movement]]
**Protests against [[President of France|French President]] [[Emmanuel Macron]] enter a fourth month in [[Paris]]. Tear gas is fired at protestors throwing stones at riot police in front of the [[Arc de Triomphe]], news stands are torched at the [[Champs-Élysées]], and a branch of [[Banque Tarneaud]] is burned. More than 80 arrests are made. Businesses around the Champs-Élysées are looted. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-france-protests/fresh-clashes-as-frances-yellow-vests-seek-new-momentum-idUKKCN1QX0AX (Reuters)]
*[[Trial of Catalonia independence leaders]], [[Catalan independentism]]
**Thousands of demonstrators protest in [[Madrid]] against the trial of Catalan independence leaders and the ongoing detention of some of them. Local police say around 18,000 protestors were involved; organisers claim almost 120,000. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-47597473 (BBC News)]
